gaps.term: convolution over the ring on the remaining axes
gaps.quote: so the polynomial product on the remaining axes is a convolution over the ring, not a cyclic one.
gaps.note: The page asserts that the product on the remaining axes becomes a convolution over the polynomial ring, but it never defines a convolution over a ring of polynomial-valued entries, never says how the remaining axes are indexed, and never shows why the signed wrap of the last axis carries through them. The reader cannot check this claim from the page.
